client_alerts.headline: OpenAI to train on personal-account Daybreak Blue sessions from Nov 29
client_alerts.body: An OpenAI email reported to users says personal-account Daybreak Blue session data will be used for model training starting **November 29, 2026**. Business, Enterprise and Zero Data Retention accounts are reportedly unaffected. Sources disagree on whether the 'Improve the model' toggle is honoured, so any client staff using personal accounts for security or DR exercises should stop or move to a business tenant before Saturday.

client_alerts.headline: OpenRouter withdraws zero-data-retention eligibility from 125 endpoints
client_alerts.body: In a Nov 22 response OpenRouter said it removed three providers and pulled ZDR eligibility from 125 endpoints, some as a precaution. Clients routing through OpenRouter on the assumption of ZDR should re-check which endpoints they actually hit and update their AI vendor register.

top_moves.title: OpenAI tests 'Private Inference' confidential computing for business customers
top_moves.body: Sam Altman says OpenAI is piloting an alpha in which business prompts run in a confidential-computing enclave OpenAI cannot read, part of a wider 'Private Intelligence' push. If it ships, it changes the data-handling answer for regulated BCP/DR clients who have so far kept OpenAI out of scope.

top_moves.title: Daybreak Blue training change takes effect Saturday
top_moves.body: Personal-account Daybreak Blue sessions become training data from Nov 29; opt-out terms are reported inconsistently. Treat any client security-exercise data entered on personal accounts as exposed after that date.

top_moves.title: ChatGPT merges Chat and Work into one usage meter
top_moves.body: Chat and Work now draw on a single usage limit. OpenAI expects most users to see no change, but the heaviest users may hit resets sooner, so long agentic Work runs can now crowd out ordinary chat.

providers.name: OpenAI
providers.headline: Private Inference alpha, a merged Chat/Work usage meter, and a Nov 29 Daybreak Blue training change.
providers.detail: Altman announced a confidential-computing 'Private Inference' alpha for a small group of business customers. Chat and Work in ChatGPT now share one usage meter. Personal-account Daybreak Blue sessions become training data from Nov 29, and the Nov 20 usage policy bars using OpenAI outputs to train rival models.

providers.name: Anthropic
providers.headline: ANT reportedly closes below its IPO price; the Claude API was rewritten in Rust (~70% less CPU in one region).
providers.detail: Post-IPO trading reportedly dipped below the $83 offer price. Engineering says the Claude API was rewritten in Rust, cutting CPU use about 70% in one tested region and memory use across production. A report says Google guarantees the debt behind a $19B Anthropic data-centre lease in Kentucky. Opus 4.8 fast-mode removal (and reportedly Sonnet 4.5 retirement) is still Nov 30.

providers.name: Google Gemini
providers.headline: Workspace AI agents must connect via MCP servers or the Workspace CLI from Feb 1, 2027.
providers.detail: Following this week's GA of Workspace MCP servers and CLI, Google set Feb 1, 2027 as the date after which Workspace AI agents must use those paths, citing security risk. Gemini 4 Neon (Nov 18) and Hydrogen (Nov 12) are the current releases. Separately, its next-gen TPU packaging test with Intel is reportedly struggling on yields.

providers.headline: Quiet. Grok 4.7 is still the latest model; Grok 5 is unreleased.
providers.detail: No new releases found. Grok Voice 3.0 (Oct 14) and the speech APIs (Oct 12) are the most recent ships.

providers.detail: The Amazon cease-and-desist over Comet agent purchases from early November is unresolved in public reporting.

providers.detail: No new post-Ignite announcements found. Autopilot timing and admin controls remain 'to be announced' in Message Center.
